description: This file defines the HarTracer class responsible for capturing and exporting HTTP Archive (HAR) data during browser or network request activities within the Playwright testing framework. It manages request/response events, creates HAR entries, handles content embedding or attachment, and generates the final HAR log.

classes.name: HarTracer
classes.description: Class responsible for tracing network requests and responses to generate a HAR log, supporting features like content embedding, request/response timing, and event handling within Playwright.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes HarTracer with context, page, delegate, and options.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins tracing, sets up event listeners for network and page events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops tracing, removes event listeners, and compiles the HAR log.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Waits for all ongoing network activities to complete.
